get.description: Live read endpoint. Returns only active-session user's accessible Workspaces with private/no-store caching. Cursor is signed, account-bound and expires after one hour.

post.description: Live owner-scoped creation endpoint. The billing account is selected from the authenticated owner, never from the request body.

get.description: Live read endpoint. Only owners and current members can read a Workspace; missing or invisible IDs return the same 404. Response is private/no-store.

schema.description: Opaque server-issued ID. Production entity IDs are UUIDs; analysis row IDs can be stable short IDs.

patch.description: Owner-only name and archive/restore update. Revision mismatch returns 409; archiving retains records and revokes pending invitations.

post.description: Owner-only email invitation. The one-use token is stored as a keyed digest and sent in a URL fragment; only editor/viewer roles are accepted.

schema.description: Opaque server-issued ID. Production entity IDs are UUIDs; analysis row IDs can be stable short IDs.

202.description: Invitation accepted for delivery; private response is no-store

get.description: Owner-only list of unexpired invitations. Secret token material is never returned.
Returns up to ten private immutable profile snapshots for an authorized Workspace member.
Read project-profile details for an authorized Workspace owner, editor, or viewer. Responses are private and not cached.

200.description: Project profile; private responses are no-store

patch.description: Live project-profile update for owners and editors. Viewer writes are denied. Revision mismatch returns 409; only the owner may mark onboarding complete.

get.description: Live private profile read for current Workspace members. Response is private/no-store.

200.description: Project profile; private responses are no-store

get.description: Lists private import batch summaries for Workspace members.

post.description: Atomically saves a mapped legacy snapshot. An active same-digest batch is idempotent within its Workspace.

200.description: Existing batch returned for an idempotent request

409.description: Idempotency key conflict or archived Workspace

get.description: Returns the mapped data and sanitized recovery backup to Workspace members.

200.description: Private import batch and recoverable snapshot

delete.description: Soft-undo the active batch while retaining its snapshot for recovery. Owner or batch creator only.

204.description: Batch is undone; its recovery snapshot remains stored

403.description: Only the Workspace owner or creator may undo this batch

post.description: Validates and maps a legacy backup without writing data. Owner/editor only.

get.description: Owner-only member list. The Workspace owner is derived from owner_id and is not a removable Membership row.

patch.description: Owner-only role change. Roles are limited to editor and viewer; ownership cannot be changed through Membership.

delete.description: Owner-only immediate membership revocation. The Workspace owner is protected.
Owner-only immediate revocation of an unaccepted invitation.

post.description: Accepts a one-use invitation only when the verified account email matches the invitation address.
